purpose: Teach: 本紙/減速/同市/出馬/課せ/部類/大綱/適性

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、本紙の論評を参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — use our paper's editorial as a reference point.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Slight pause before the task. Steady gaze. The tone of someone who trusts you and expects you to rise to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の進度を減速して見直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll slow down the research pace and review it carefully.
lines.style: Quick, respectful confirmation. Slight catch of breath before committing to the plan. Earnest — not performative. The voice of someone already taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、同市内の他研究機関とも連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with other research institutions in the same city.
lines.style: Clear directive, slightly firmer than before. No room for ambiguity. Professional but not cold. A senior who expects compliance because it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の理事に出馬を勧められました
lines.en: Yes. A board member at the conference actually recommended I run for election.
lines.style: Quiet, almost hesitant — offering information he wasn't directly asked for. Slightly proud underneath but checked. Testing the waters to see if this is something he should pursue.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学生に過度の課題を課せないよう注意しろ
lines.en: Ren — be careful not to overload your students with assignments.
lines.style: Shift to gentler concern. Still authoritative, but the instruction carries care underneath. This matters to him as a person, not just a supervisor. Eye contact softens slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。優秀な論文の部類に入る研究をします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure my research reaches the standard of excellent work.
lines.style: Immediate, steady reassurance. No defensiveness — just quiet commitment. The breath is centered, grounded. He's already thinking about how to execute this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士論文の大綱を作成しろ
lines.en: Ren — create an outline for your doctoral dissertation.
lines.style: Final instruction, slightly more expansive. Leaning back slightly — giving him room to think. The confidence of someone who believes this person can do it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマと自分の適性を見極めます
lines.en: Yes. I need to clarify my research theme and make sure it aligns with my strengths.
lines.style: Thoughtful close. Deeper breath — this one carries weight. Not rushing the answer. The tone of someone examining himself honestly, gathering resolve for the longer journey ahead.
